annotations.text:
Vyno — rebrand concept for EatUp.
Illustrated food graphics stand in for real photography (none supplied). Static high-fidelity mockups, not a clickable prototype.
Core order-ahead flow: onboarding → discover → menu → checkout → live tracking → confirmation.
Same brand system on desktop: consumer-facing marketing hero and the restaurant partner dashboard.

Confirmed: Vyno = the meal-planner / fridge-scan app. This is the current source of truth for the product.
Standalone mobile landing page for organic install acquisition — single scrolling page, no site nav, hero screen + how-it-works + two feature screenshots (shopping list, budget), one CTA repeated (App Store download).
Pages 1-3 still tell the order-ahead pickup story and need realigning to this product.
